description: Optimise a multi-task LLM workload by assigning the cheapest qualifying model to each task instead of running everything through one model. Takes a list of workloads (task type + monthly volume + optional quality floor and capability requirements) and returns a per-task model allocation, the total monthly cost, and the saving versus the best single-model deployment. If a monthly budget is given, leftover headroom is spent on the most cost-efficient quality upgrades. Use when the user asks how to cut LLM spend across several task types, or whether tiered model routing is worth it.

min_quality_score.description: Global quality floor (0-100) applied to every workload

monthly_budget_usd.description: Total monthly budget in USD. Leftover headroom is spent on the most cost-efficient quality upgrades.

workloads.description: One entry per task type in the workload mix

avg_output_tokens.description: Average completion size in tokens. Derived from the task profile when omitted.

label.description: Friendly name for this workload in the output

min_context_tokens.description: Minimum context window required for this task

min_quality_score.description: Quality floor (0-100) for this task specifically

monthly_requests.description: Expected requests per month for this task

task_type.description: Task category driving the input/output token ratio

name: optimize_workload
